name: Matter of Respect
s: Ayvalik is brought into play by the mob from a family who came to Istanbul. Yigit's father committed suicide because of the mob.

paragraphs.text: Şeref Meselesi (), is a prime time Turkish television drama series produced by D Productions and broadcast from November 23, 2014, on Kanal D.
It is an adaptation of Italian 18-episode series published between 2006 and 2012, L'onore e il rispetto. Last episode was aired on May 17, 2015, at Kanal D channel.
